item.text: {"category_edits":[{"category":"learning_objective","rationale":"Apply temperature 0.5 to full-catalog masked-item cross-entropy across all four datasets. Architecture, sampling, inference scores and checkpoint shapes remain unchanged.","edits":[{"find":"    return torch.nn.functional.cross_entropy(logits, targets, reduction=\"mean\")","replace":"    return torch.nn.functional.cross_entropy(logits / 0.5, targets, reduction=\"mean\")"}]}],"change_summary":"Use temperature-0.5 masked-item cross-entropy for each category’s single BERT4Rec model; predictor changes are unnecessary."}
